data.text: Number of days changed from 30 days to 21 days in the following sentence: the inhibitory effect of zinc on intestinal copper absorption is expected to be minimal 30 21 days after discontinuation of zinc. To align the number of days with the mention of zinc discontinuation elsewhere in the protocol.
data.sourceSection: Protocol Amendment Summary of Changes Table - Section 4.2 Scientific Rationale for Study Design

text.quote: Number of days changed from 30 days to 21 days in the following sentence: • However, the physiologic turnover of human gastrointestinal epithelial cells is 3 - 5 days (Darwich, 2014); therefore, the inhibitory effect of zinc on intestinal copper absorption is expected to be minimal 30 21 days after discontinuation of zinc.
